progression.prerequisiteKnowledge: C2 reaction rate, reversible approach and activation-energy introduction; C3 fixed-temperature equilibrium/K distinction. Refresh rate as change per unit time and activation energy as an energy hurdle. Entry check: does faster forward reaction alone tell us the final mixture? Support route: revisit C2 equal opposing rates and C3 temperature/K. C4A precedes this delivery part in the selected route; actual availability is not assumed.
progression.startsWith: Initially product-forming closed mixtures with identical reacting substances, reacting amounts, initial composition, fixed container volume and temperature. A catalyst opens a reversible pathway without introducing another equilibrium reaction.
progression.stopsAfter: Lower alternative pathway assisting both directions, faster approach, equal rates at equilibrium, same fixed-temperature equilibrium composition and K; distinguish finite-time product amount. No Q/K calculations, industrial conditions, universal enhancement factor or detailed catalytic cycle.
progression.nextLesson: C5 equilibrium expressions, with p01 practical support as appropriate; C7 later applies industrial rate/finite-time/equilibrium distinctions.

teaching.task: Explain the lower alternative pathway, faster approach and unchanged fixed-temperature equilibrium composition and K under matching conditions.
teaching.causalExplanation: Lower activation barrier permits a faster reversible pathway. Reactant/product energy levels and fixed-temperature equilibrium relationship are unchanged. Net composition stops changing when opposing rates balance, not when reactions stop. Same starting composition, reacting amounts, volume and temperature produce the same equilibrium composition; earlier product can differ for the specified product-forming start.
teaching.conversationalApproach: Preserve useful accepted C4 preparation language, split profile/K/approach/already-equilibrium into separate current stages. Add plain axis meanings and reversible-rate explanation. These exact new selected words are unreviewed until independent assessment.
teaching.openingDecision: Contrast sooner product with more product at equilibrium. Rhetorical opener, not claimed retrieval evidence.
teaching.understandingCheck: Retain all matched initial conditions, closed-system scope, initially product-forming state, only-one-catalyst condition and both before/after demands throughout estimated 12-second response. Prompt allowance derives from 2.25 words/s plus a settling second; outgoing 24-frame protection keeps feedback after the declared hold end. Fresh audio must set actual timing.
teaching.curriculumScope: Chemistry Stage 6 2017 Year 12 M5, canonical chem-m5-c04 delivery C4B. Candidate C-activation subset from cached NESA p1072. Profile/qualitative prediction does not establish investigation, practical conduct, complete heat-of-reaction teaching or syllabus-action approval.
